line: Out in the world: above and below
giver: The world itself: quests that appear when the player reaches a floating island, an airship or a sky village, or finds a hidden place underground.
feel: Vertigo and darkness: climbing, grappling and flying up to islands in the sky; quiet, careful exploring of what's buried. Airships and the ancient city wait for later acts.

quests.title: Islands in the Sky
quests.summary: Spotting a floating island overhead starts it. Get up there by any means (pillar, grapple, wings) and stand on it.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a Grappling Hook, ender pearls

quests.title: Sky Hopper
quests.summary: Set foot on five different floating islands, from the small huts to the rivers in the sky.
quests.reward: Agility XP, feather falling boots

quests.title: Fire Overhead
quests.summary: A volcano floats in the sky, dripping lava over the edge. Reach its crater and mine the magma and ores at its core without falling through.
quests.reward: Mining XP, obsidian, a fire resistance potion

quests.title: Castle in the Clouds
quests.summary: A ruined castle and towers float above the land, held by skeletons. Storm the castle and take the banner from its highest tower.
quests.reward: Attack XP, an enchanted bow, a banner

quests.title: The Pyramid Aloft
quests.summary: A desert pyramid floats over the dunes, its sand somehow holding. Find the way in from below and solve its tomb lock.
quests.reward: Mining XP, gold, sandstone

quests.title: Castaway Above
quests.summary: A palm island floats over the sea with a castaway's hammock and no way down. Collect its coconuts and leave a ladder for the next one.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, coconuts, a palm sapling

quests.title: Ice Fishing in the Sky
quests.summary: A frozen pond floats in the sky. Cut a hole in the ice and catch a fish up there.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, bait, a fishing hook

quests.title: A Portal in the Sky
quests.summary: A nether portal sits alone on a floating rock. Report it to the Arcane order, who want to know who built it so high.
quests.reward: Magic XP, obsidian

quests.title: The Sky Garden
quests.summary: Forests float in the sky: jungle, mangrove, mushroom, taiga, cherry and birch rivers. Bring back saplings from three different sky forests and plant them at home.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, bone meal

quests.title: The Sky Hermit
quests.summary: Small houses float in the sky, and one of them still has a hermit who never comes down. Bring him supplies from the ground and hear why he left.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a slow falling potion

quests.title: Drifting Rocks
quests.summary: Moog's floating islands hang low over the land with chests on top. Reach the large floating island's chest with a grappling hook alone.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a grappling hook rope upgrade

quests.title: The Village above the Clouds
quests.summary: A sky village floats on its own island. Get up to it, meet its villagers and make your first trade there.
quests.reward: Agility XP, emeralds, a slow falling potion

quests.title: Boarding Party
quests.summary: An airship drifts overhead, crewed by illagers. Get aboard, clear the decks and take the captain's chest before it sails away.
quests.reward: Range XP, an enchanted crossbow, rockets

quests.title: The Drifting Blimp
quests.summary: A small blimp floats unmanned above the hills. Climb aboard, read the pilot's engine notes and use them to build your own Immersive Aircraft.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, Immersive Aircraft engine parts

quests.title: The Highest Point
quests.summary: Fly or climb to the build limit and look down. Icarus wings, an aircraft or a pillar of dirt all count.
quests.reward: Agility XP, firework rockets

quests.title: The Silent City
quests.summary: Finding an ancient city in the deep dark. Cross it to the great portal frame without waking the Warden, sneaking past every shrieker.
quests.reward: Magic XP, swift sneak, echo shards

quests.title: Echoes
quests.summary: Picking up an echo shard starts it. Find eight and craft a recovery compass, then die on purpose (carefully) and follow it back.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a recovery compass

quests.title: Fragments of a Song
quests.summary: Finding a disc fragment starts it. Collect nine and assemble the strange disc, then play it somewhere quiet.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a jukebox, sculk

quests.title: The Bunker
quests.summary: A sealed bunker lies under the hills, its doors on a redstone lock. Restore power by finding its levers in the right order and open the vault.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, redstone, iron

quests.title: A House Underground
quests.summary: A house buried under the ground, lit and furnished, with nobody in it. Find out from the diary who dug it, and bring the owner's lost pickaxe back from the cave beyond.
quests.reward: Mining XP, torches, an iron pickaxe

quests.title: The Cellar under the Ruin
quests.summary: A taiga ruin has a cellar underneath. Find the entrance, light it up and recover what the ruin's people hid below.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a Torchmaster megatorch part, coal

quests.title: The Mossy Cave
quests.summary: A small cave in the taiga lined with forest moss. Collect its moss and the flowers growing in the light from the opening.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, forest moss

quests.title: A Carved Tablet
quests.summary: Finding a cave tablet starts it. Its carvings show a place far below; take it to a cartographer, who knows what it's worth.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a map

quests.title: The Glittering Nest
quests.summary: An amethyst nest grows in a lush cave, guarded by amethyst crabs. Hunt the crabs until one drops a perfect geode heart (quest item).
quests.reward: Mining XP, amethyst blocks, a spyglass

quests.title: Into the Deep Dark
quests.summary: Entering the deep dark for the first time. Collect a sculk sensor without setting off a shrieker.
quests.reward: Mining XP, sculk

quests.title: Lush Caves
quests.summary: Entering lush caves. Collect glow berries and catch an axolotl in a bucket.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, a bucket of axolotl

quests.title: Teeth of Stone
quests.summary: Entering dripstone caves. Collect pointed dripstone and fill a cauldron by dripping water.
quests.reward: Mining XP, a cauldron

quests.title: Red Veins
quests.summary: Entering Regions Unexplored's redstone caves. Mine the raw redstone that grows on the walls.
quests.reward: Mining XP, redstone

quests.title: The Prismachasm
quests.summary: Entering the prismachasm, full of prismatic glass. Bring back its shining crystals.
quests.reward: Mining XP, prismoss

quests.title: Webs Everywhere
quests.summary: Stumbling into a Biomes O' Plenty spider nest. Get out the other side within three minutes, killing the spiders that block the way.
quests.reward: Attack XP, string, a Bane of Arthropods book
